messages.english: Follow saved grower cycles on their exact planned dates.
messages.text: Tevhelani mitingatingo ya vhulimi yo vhulungwaho nga madatumu ayo o pulaniwaho nga ho livhaho.

messages.english: Check current designs before ticking work or exporting dates.
messages.text: Tolani pulane dza zwino musi ni sa athu swaya mushumo kana u bvisa madatumu.

messages.english: Keep own crop estimates separate from catalogue print advice.
messages.text: Vhulungani ndinganyelo dzaṋu dza zwilimwa dzo fhambana na nyeletshedzo ya khathalogo yo gandiswaho.
Tsedzulusani mushumo waṋu u re na madatumu

messages.english: Task Planner → Dated work from your estimates
messages.text: Mupulani wa Mishumo → Mushumo u re na madatumu u bvaho kha ndinganyelo dzaṋu

messages.english: Open Task Planner to check work dates from your saved growing estimates.
messages.text: Vulani Mupulani wa Mishumo u itela u tola madatumu a mushumo a bvaho kha ndinganyelo dzaṋu dza vhulimi dzo vhulungwaho.
